cloud_regions.method: Region codes and locations copied from the clouds' own documentation pages, opened 2026-11-08. A region code names where the endpoint's data centers are; it is the strongest local evidence of where a request is processed.
notes: AWS: commercial regions from the AWS Regions page (Geography column gives the country). GovCloud codes from the Bedrock endpoints page; China codes from the AWS China endpoints guide.
AWS Bedrock: bedrock_runtime lists the 22 regions in the 'Amazon Bedrock runtime APIs' table of https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/bedrock.html; model availability varies by region.

GCP: the Vertex AI locations page now redirects to the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform docs. 'global', 'us' and 'eu' come from the generative AI locations page, which warns that these endpoints do not guarantee data residency; they carry no single country.
GCP southamerica-west1: the accelerators table says Osasco, Brazil, contradicting the region list and feature table (Santiago, Chile); Santiago/CL is used.

fingerprints_meta.source: Candidate repos from aitools.json (entry tags/topics); identifiers read from each repo's own manifests via GitHub GraphQL at HEAD.
